about: Year-specific Gaokao mathematics paper usage by province-level region, 2016-2026. Each mapping cites its sources (S..) with verbatim quotes; 'conflict' entries carry a provisional assignment explained in 'conflicts'. Region keys follow services/past_papers.py REGIONS; series keys follow services/past_papers.py SERIES. Shanghai spring papers: see shanghai_spring.

region_notes.xizang: 西藏 on 全国卷II in 2016 (S01).

region_notes.sichuan: 四川 used 全国卷III only for 语文/文综 in 2016; its math was 四川卷 (S01, S03).

jiangsu.tracks_note: One paper (数学Ⅰ for all) plus 附加题 for 选修物理 candidates; not a 文/理 split.

zhejiang.tracks_note: 文/理 split only from the eol 2016 tab (S05); Sina S01 lists just 数学理 for 浙江; deekur has separate gk2016-zhejiang-l/-w files (S56).

region_notes.shandong: 山东 used 全国卷I only for 外语/文综/理综; math self-set (S06).

PROVISIONAL. eol's own 西藏 paper pages for 2017 show the 全国卷3 papers (S58) and its 西藏 download links go to 云南/广西 pages (S10); deekur (S56) and 百度百科 (S57) also put 西藏 on Ⅲ in 2017. Contradicted by the province lists cited under national_2.

jiangsu.tracks_note: 数学Ⅰ + 附加题 (选修物理), not a 文/理 split.

region_notes.xizang: Resolved to 全国甲卷 (文/理) on the strength of 西藏's official 2023 rule '数学(分文理科)' (S34): in 2023 only 甲卷/乙卷 math were split, and 甲卷 is 西藏's prior lineage; deekur agrees (S56). But eol's post-exam index (S31) lists 西藏 统考科目 under 新课标Ⅱ卷 and the pre-exam overview (S32) does too; no source states '西藏 数学 = 全国甲卷' explicitly for 2023.

region_notes.yunnan|shanxi|anhui|jilin|heilongjiang: Still in the old 文/理 system (文/理综合 on 新课标卷) but took the single unsplit 新课标Ⅱ卷 math paper (S31).
region_notes.xizang: eol (S31, S32) also lists 西藏 here; excluded per the resolution under national_jia.

eol index states '西藏（数学、英语、理综）' under 全国甲卷 (S36); 西藏 official rule '数学（分文理科）' (S39) and the official note that 全国甲卷 had 文/理 papers (S40) agree. Generic eol articles saying 西藏 used 新课标Ⅱ卷 (S37, S38) refer to 语文 / are internally inconsistent - see conflicts.

region_notes.henan: Old 文/理 system (文/理综合 on 新课标卷) but took the unsplit 新课标Ⅰ卷 math paper (S36).

region_notes.yunnan|shanxi|xinjiang: Old 文/理 system (文/理综合 on 新课标卷) but took the unsplit 新课标Ⅱ卷 math paper (S36).
region_notes.xizang: Only 西藏 语文 used 新课标Ⅱ卷 (S36 '西藏（语文）'); math was 全国甲卷.

region_notes.xizang|xinjiang: Still 3+文科综合/理科综合 (old system) but math is the single unsplit 全国二卷 ('数学（不分文理科）', S43 for 西藏).
region_notes.sichuan|neimenggu|shaanxi|qinghai|ningxi: 2025 is the first new-gaokao year for this reform cohort (e.g. 四川 '不再分文理科', S44).

region_notes.xizang: Official 2026 rule lists 数学 without a 文/理 split (S47).

conflicts.detail: Pre-exam lists (Sina Dec-2015 table S02; eol 2016-06-07 article S03) put 贵州/广西/云南 on 全国卷II and have no 全国卷III; the eol 2016-2018 template index (S05) lists 西藏 under 全国卷III.
conflicts.resolution: Superseded by the post-exam Sina 2016 summary (S01): Ⅲ = 广西、贵州、云南 (+四川 语文/文综 only); 西藏 on Ⅱ. The eol template lines are not year-specific.

conflicts.detail: 西藏 2017: every province LIST found puts 西藏 on 全国卷II (Sina summary S06, Sina 文数Ⅱ header S07, Sina Ⅲ header S08 omitting 西藏, eol 数学汇总 S09, eol 西藏-channel nav S10, eol 四川 page S59). But eol's 西藏-channel PAPER pages for 2017 display the 全国卷3 文数 and 语文 papers (S58), its 西藏 download links go to 云南/广西 (Ⅲ) pages (S10), and deekur (S56) and 百度百科 (S57, snippet) put 西藏 on Ⅲ from 2017.
conflicts.resolution: UNRESOLVED; provisionally 西藏 -> national_3 (agreeing with deekur). Reasoning: the Ⅱ-lists repeat 2016 / Dec-2016 pre-exam wording and order verbatim (Sina's order 甘青藏黑吉辽宁新蒙陕渝 is its 2016 list; eol's matches its 2016-12-27 pre-exam article), and Sina's Ⅲ math header is demonstrably stale (its 2019 Ⅲ header S22 also omits 西藏, contradicting Sina's own 2019 summary). The Ⅲ evidence is per-province content chosen after the exam. 西藏 is on Ⅲ in all 2018 lists (S11, S12, S15, S16). Both 2017 series marked 'conflict'; an official 2017 西藏 notice is still needed.

conflicts.detail: Sina 2018 topic page (S15) omits 辽宁 from 全国卷II.
conflicts.resolution: 辽宁 kept on Ⅱ per eol S11/S13 and Sina 理综 Ⅱ page (sina_2018_n2_lizong.html).

conflicts.detail: Sina's 2019 全国卷III 理数 page header (S22) lists only 云南、广西、贵州、四川.
conflicts.resolution: Kept 西藏 on Ⅲ: Sina's own 2019 summary (S18) and eol (S20) include 西藏; S22's header text is identical to Sina's 2017 template (S08).

conflicts.detail: A Sina 2020 全国卷I 文综 page (seen in search results, not saved) lists 山东 among 全国卷I regions.
conflicts.resolution: 山东 took 新高考全国Ⅰ卷 in 2020 (S23, S24 summary lists exclude 山东 from 全国I and title the 山东 papers 新高考全国卷Ⅰ山东).

conflicts.detail: 西藏 math: eol post-exam index (S31) puts 西藏 统考科目 on 新课标Ⅱ卷 and 甲卷 only for 文理综合; eol pre-exam overview (S32) and eol 西藏 article (S33) say 新课标2卷. Official 西藏 2023 rule (S34) says 数学(分文理科); 2023 新课标Ⅱ卷 math was a single unsplit paper, so a 文/理 split implies 全国甲卷. deekur (S56) and several community posts list 西藏 on 甲卷 for math.
conflicts.resolution: UNRESOLVED BY DIRECT STATEMENT; provisionally 西藏 -> national_jia (文/理). Both affected series marked 'conflict'. A 2023 西藏 exam-authority notice naming the math paper would settle it.

conflicts.detail: Some 2023 web lists (gk100, sohu, an eol '几套试卷' article seen only in search results) give 乙卷 as 12 provinces or swap 内蒙古 for 安徽; gk100 lists 云南 under 甲卷.
conflicts.resolution: Those are pre-exam/carry-over lists; post-exam eol index (S31) gives 乙卷 = 8, 甲卷 without 云南, and 安徽/云南 on 新课标Ⅱ卷. deekur agrees.

conflicts.detail: eol articles of 2024-06-07 say 西藏 used 新课标Ⅱ卷 (S37 语文 table; S38 西藏 article, which also says 数学分文理科).
conflicts.resolution: Resolved: eol's subject-specific index (S36) puts 西藏 数学 on 全国甲卷 and only 语文 on 新课标Ⅱ卷; consistent with the official 数学（分文理科） rule (S39) and 甲卷 文/理 papers (S40).

conflicts.detail: eol 2024 语文 table (S37) lists 重庆 under 新课标Ⅰ卷.
conflicts.resolution: Error in that table; 重庆 on 新课标Ⅱ卷 per eol index (S36) and all other sources.

shanghai_spring.question: Are Shanghai spring-session (春季高考/春考) math papers officially released, or do they circulate only as recollected copies?
shanghai_spring.finding: No official release found. The 上海市教育考试院 publishes the exam rules and an expert commentary (专家点评) after each spring math exam, but not the paper text; its own publication lists carry a 试题汇编 only for the 中考. Candidates must hand in the paper ('不得将试卷…带出考场'), and the copies that circulate are reconstructions explicitly labelled 回忆版 / 网络收集版 / 练习 by their compilers - including the deekur lineage held in this workspace.

shanghai_spring.deekur_file_label_notes: First line of each deekur 上海春季 PDF in originals/. 2016 reproduces the paper's full 考生注意 block (两考合一 with 学业水平考试), so a full copy of the printed 2016 paper evidently circulated, but no official publication of it was found; 2017/2018 use a compiler's '年.月' header; 2021 says 网络收集版, 2022/2024/2025 say 练习, 2026 says 回忆版; 2020/2023 carry no label. No 2019 spring paper is in the deekur inventory.
open_leads: A Scribd upload titled '2024年上海市普通高校春季招生统一文化考试 数学试卷 (上海市教育考试院)' (S55) hints that a printed version attributed to the exam authority may exist; it comes from a piracy library and was not accessed. If an official printed source is ever located through a legitimate channel, the 2024 (and possibly other) spring papers could be re-evaluated.
eol.cn's annual 真题 indexes (2016-2026) contain no 上海春考 entries at all.
shanghai_spring.recommendation: Under BRIEF §1 ('回忆版/估分版 copies are not acceptable lineages; if only recollected copies exist, quarantine'), treat every gk20xx-shanghai-spring candidate (2016-2018, 2020-2026) as recollected-only: quarantine unless an official/printed lineage is found.
shanghai_spring.caveat: The 'paper must be handed in' rule (S50) also applies to Shanghai's June exam, so the rule alone is not proof; the conclusion rests on the absence of any official publication plus the compilers' own 回忆版/网络收集版/练习 labels. Provenance of the Shanghai June (秋考) papers was NOT investigated here.

notes: Scope: summer Gaokao mathematics, 2016-2026 (2019-2026 priority). gk2010 candidates in inventory are out of scope and not covered.

Series keys: national_1/2/3 = 全国Ⅰ/Ⅱ/Ⅲ卷 (2016-2020); national_jia (2021-2024); national_yi (2021-2023); new_curriculum_1/2 = 新高考Ⅰ/Ⅱ卷 (2020-2022) = 新课标Ⅰ/Ⅱ卷 (2023-2024); national_1_2025/national_2_2025 = 全国一卷/二卷 (2025-2026); other keys are regional self-set papers. Regional keys 'shandong' (2016-2017) and 'sichuan' (2016) are self-set MATH papers of years when those provinces used national papers only for other subjects.

tracks: ['science','liberal'] means the paper itself existed as separate 理科/文科 versions; [] means one paper for everyone. Several old-system (文/理) provinces sat unsplit new-curriculum math papers: 2023 山西/吉林/黑龙江/安徽/云南 (新课标Ⅱ卷), 2024 河南 (新课标Ⅰ卷) and 山西/云南/新疆 (新课标Ⅱ卷), 2025-2026 西藏/新疆 (全国二卷). See region_notes.
西藏 is split by subject in 2023-2024: 语文 (and 政治/历史) moved to new-curriculum papers while math stayed on the old-curriculum 全国甲卷 (文/理). Mappings here are for MATH only.
海南 2016-2019 used 全国卷II for 语数外 only; math is therefore national_2 (文/理).

eol.cn per-year index pages for 2016, 2017 and 2018 share one template with identical 适用地区 lines (2018 values); they are not used as year-specific evidence for 2016/2017. eol 2019st.shtml is a 404; 2019 evidence comes from eol per-paper pages and Sina.

'confirmed' = at least one official or major-media source explicitly giving that year's province list for the paper (or, for self-set papers, naming the regional math paper) and no unresolved conflict. Sina Education (新浪教育) is treated as major media alongside 中国教育在线/新华网/人民网.

Every quote with a local_copy was machine-checked (whitespace-insensitive) against text extracted from the saved page; quotes from S52-S57 were not (see each note). Fetched pages are stored under research/regions/pages/.
